## Scope and independence

Independent nonauthor review of complete M3 commit 5b045bab against M2 c048b647. Parent distribution-implementer authored source/tests/evidence; this reviewer only inspected and executed isolated temporary reproductions. Current context selects M3 and registered implementation-m3 evidence; upstream design-review-r5 and delivery-review-r2 remain the governing approved package. No implementation, upstream content, routing or work state was edited. Initial first-pass finding is recorded before author correction, preserving exact subjects and reproductions.

## Checklist

1. Spec alignment: concern. Mirror producer/test removal and package protection transfer follow M3, but the new output guard does not satisfy DIST-SR-05 existing runtime preservation. The actual deletion and overwrite reproductions below contradict the report claim.
2. Test coverage: concern. Independent canonical file/raw-byte inventory and explicit malformed generated frontmatter are valuable real replacement checks. Stale/missing resources and malformed source remain directly checked. Output guard cases cover equal/below source/active roots and a top-level source alias, but miss ancestor cleanup and symlinks beneath an otherwise safe output root.
3. Edge cases: concern. Exact runtime roots reject; target parents and nested output aliases can still mutate installed runtime files. This is an observable safety gap, not merely a request for a larger test matrix.
4. Error handling: concern. Guard returns success for both demonstrated unsafe output placements, after which sync_adapter_output writes/cleans runtime content. Required pre-mutation rejection is absent. Correction must cover all actual writer paths and preserve bytes on failure.
5. Architecture boundaries: concern. The retained archive/tree producer must not become an alternative installer. Current implementation crosses that boundary through existing output paths. No new state schema or wider platform mechanism is needed; correction belongs to existing producer containment.
6. Compatibility: pass for other inspected changes. Retired command IDs are absent from current catalog but preserved as explicit historical rows; deletion paths still classify to real replacement checks. Broad-smoke current child classification reflects ten commands while historical timing/ledger records retain original facts. M4 document links are expressly not claimed complete here.
7. Security/privacy: concern limited to the confirmed filesystem writes/deletions. No credentials or external publication permissions changed. Temporary reviewer fixtures alone were mutated; actual installed repository runtime directories were not used for reproduction.
8. Derived artifact currency: pass apart from unsafe output guard. Canonical independent inventory checks both supported archives; Claude body/resource comparison is separate from allowed frontmatter projection checks. Candidate tests copy the actual script tree so removed scripts cannot survive through a stale baseline clone. Real C3/C8 generated/packed proof is registered.
9. Unrelated changes: pass. Removed files are the two approved mirror scripts; current CI/release/catalog and historical reader projections are necessary callers. Broad-smoke current configuration is operational despite its old change-directory location; original historical timing and ledger bytes are preserved. README one-line mirror command removal is scoped.
10. Validation evidence: pass as executed observations, insufficient for approval of the missing safety cases. Report records seven old mirror checks, actual pre-deletion replacement checks, owner admission and four requested measurements. Controlled isolated comparison records four affected commands becoming two, twelve broad children becoming ten, exact line counts and maintenance ownership; different target populations and host load are disclosed without a performance guarantee. C3 153, C5 358/19, C6 157/14, C7 90/112 and selected C8 passes do not prove the untested overlap boundaries. No new runtime suite was necessary to establish the two concrete failures.

## Material finding

Finding ID: dist-m3-generation-runtime-overlap

Severity: major

Location: scripts/adapter_distribution.py:_validate_generation_output and sync_adapter_output (guard around line1693; output writes and stale cleanup around line1725), with applicable build_adapter_archives/build_staged_v3_adapter_archives writer interactions.

Evidence: On exact handoff, a reviewer temporary fixture created <tmp>/.codex/skills/user/SKILL.md containing USER CONTENT. Calling sync_adapter_output('v1.0.0', output_root=<tmp>/.codex) returned successfully and the existing runtime file no longer existed. The guard checks whether output itself contains a .codex/skills pair, while stale cleanup traverses its descendant skills directory. A second independent fixture set output=<tmp>/out, created output/codex/.agents as a directory symlink to <tmp>/.codex, and prepopulated .codex/skills/proposal/SKILL.md. sync_adapter_output returned successfully and that file no longer contained USER CONTENT: generated writes followed a symlink below the validated output root. Both calls used real canonical skills and actual generation, without mocked validation. Stdout observations were respectively 'generation accepted; existing runtime marker preserved: False' and 'nested alias accepted; runtime content preserved: False'. Temporary trees were removed only by their context managers after observation.

Required outcome: All retained generation modes must reject unsafe overlap before any writes or cleanup, including output directories containing existing active runtime roots and symlinked descendants/destination files that redirect mutations outside the intended output. Preserve existing runtime/source bytes and inventory. A safe ordinary package output containing its expected generated package layout must still work; merely checking the top-level resolved path is insufficient.

Safe resolution path: Implement the correction in the existing output preflight/writer containment, with direct temporary regressions for ancestor cleanup, nested output alias redirection and relevant archive destination aliases. Execute meaningful negative preservation and positive ordinary/staged/tree output checks, refresh affected evidence and return for independent M3 rereview. No upstream design decision is needed: DIST-SR-05 already prohibits automatic runtime deletion/copying. Do not change historical records or expand this into installer state management.

## Handoff and limits

M3 is not closed; first-pass judgment changes-requested. Author correction may proceed only after this record exists; Route owns work/routing. The reviewer does not automatically enter downstream implementation. M4, final independent whole-change Code Review and Verify remain required. This record claims neither branch/PR readiness nor successful final CI/adoption/publication. Deleted scripts/build-skills.py and scripts/test-build-skills.py are reviewed as removals through the exact commit range; extant engineering subjects below carry mechanical identities.
